component.subject: The Lord's Prayer
component.title: Lord's Prayer
component.source: The Lord's Prayer in its traditional English form (Book of Common Prayer, 1662; American Standard Book of 1892), with this community's alternatives "Mother" and "Creator" for "Father" and "sins" for "trespasses"; the doxology omitted.

original.p: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy Name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, As it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, As we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation; But deliver us from evil. Amen.

p.line: Our Father / Mother / Creator in heaven,
Your will be done on earth
Give us this day our daily bread,
and forgive us our trespasses / sins
as we forgive those who trespass / sin against us.
And lead us not into temptation,
